ops.title: prove-ci-follow: retry when CI completes between proof failure and the CI read
ops.description: Owner: prove-ci-follow change owner. HEAD 77dbcdf5bd98732dc8a361136b58b24c584a332a. Evidence: install.py:785-795 calls await_ci only after the failing proof exits, and only True resets the deadline and retries. install.py:639-652 returns False when the first read finds completion. Thus a proof seeing in-progress CI and exiting 1 can be recorded BLOCKED if CI completes before that first read; no version change is needed or expected. The new two-run test at test_install.py:1350 supplies two running reads before completion, so it misses this interleaving. Next executable step: carry enough attempt/completion information to retry when relevant CI completed during or just after the failed attempt even if await_ci never suspended; add a deterministic first-read-completed regression. Review was code-only; no tests were run.

ops.text: A proof that exits nonzero on running CI is retried once with a fresh timeout when the first post-failure CI read already reports completion; unchanged plugin versions do not force BLOCKED.
